about_the_game:
Mimix is a strategic roguelike auto-battler where you create equipment through synthesis and break out to fight against incoming heroes.
Battles are fully automatic, and the decisions you make during preparation directly determine victory or defeat.

Game Flow

The game progresses in a cycle of Preparation Phase → Battle Phase.

Preparation Phase (limited actions)

Using the mysterious Mimic, you can perform the following actions:

  • Break out: Split items into multiple materials

  • Synthesis: Combine materials to create new items

  • Monster Creation: Combine materials to summon monsters, defeat them, and obtain new items

  • Equip: Set weapons, armor, and accessories to strengthen your forces

Within limited actions, plan the optimal equipment setup to prepare for the next battle.

Battle Phase

  • One-on-one duels against heroes (fully automated)

  • The equipment and strategy prepared beforehand decide the outcome

  • Victory grants rewards and leads back to the Preparation Phase

World

After being defeated by the heroes, the Demon Lord escapes and discovers a dungeon inhabited by a mysterious Mimic.
By harnessing its power to forge equipment, you must defeat the heroes who relentlessly pursue you.
